pages.title: Brewing Malice
pages.text: Brew an Awkward Potion with a $(l:combat/21_corrupted_wine_fox)Remnant Memory$(/l). Drink it yourself, or use the bottle on one of your tame maids.

pages.title: Drinking Malice
pages.text: The first bottle grants level 1 of Corrupted Pursuit. Each further drink adds one level, up to 255, and resets the timer to one hour. Return near your latest personal respawn point to trigger the $(l:combat/20_corrupted_hunt)pursuit$(/l).

pages.title: Feeding a Maid
pages.text: She gains 20% attack damage and attack speed and 1 Fear toward you per minute. More bottles renew the hour at the same combat bonus. She may whisper through AI about every 5 minutes. Only a player can draw the hunting party.
